match.reason: No point in the bank covers designing and developing new goods and services for production efficiency and competitive advantage; innovation and market research are related ideas but not the same.

draft.title: New product design and development
card: Product design and development is how a business plans a new good or service, or improves an existing one. It starts with what customers want and ends with something the business can make well.
decides what the product looks like, what it does and what it is made from. A good design meets customer needs and can be made at a reasonable cost.
turns the design into a working product. The business builds and tests a sample, then fixes problems before it sells to the public.
A design that is easy to make can cut waste and production time. Products that customers value can help a business stay ahead of competitors that are slower to change.
draft.remember: Good design meets customer needs and suits efficient production, which can give a business an edge.

a.q: Which choice shows a business using good product design?
opts: Making what customers want in a way that is easy to produce
Making it cheaply first, then asking what customers want
Copying a rival's product exactly so that no testing is done
Choosing the design that the factory staff like best
a.why: Good design links what customers want with what the business can make efficiently. Making first and asking later is tempting, but it risks making a product that customers do not want.
a.clue: Think about both the customer and the factory.

b.q: Priya's bakery in Orange builds and tastes a sample of a new gluten-free loaf, then changes the recipe after feedback before selling it. Which stage is this?
opts: Development, as the sample is tested and fixed before sale
Design, as the recipe is the only part of the process
Selling, as customers have already given their feedback
Design, as the product has not yet been built
b.why: Development turns a design into a working product by building and testing a sample, then fixing problems before sale. Writing the recipe is design, but this scenario goes further by building, testing and adjusting it.
b.clue: Which stage involves building a sample and fixing problems?

a.best: Making what customers want in a way that is easy to produce

b.best: Development, as the sample is tested and fixed before sale

problems.detail: The clue ('Which stage involves building a sample and fixing problems?') nearly restates the right option ('the sample is tested and fixed'), so a student can match words without understanding the difference between design and development.
